extDescription.message: Keeps sessions alive on sites you choose by preventing idle logouts. No data collection.

simulateActivityHint.message: Sends mouse and key events the page's idle timer listens for.

keepVisibleHint.message: The page always sees itself as visible and focused.

serverPingHint.message: Off by default. Requests the site root in the background so a server-side session does not expire. Some sites (admin panels, firewalls) log you out on such requests; turn it off if that happens.

unsupportedHint.message: Works only on http and https pages.

statusRedirected.message: On, last signal $1 was redirected (session may have ended)
